sanskrit_verse:
प्रमादान् नाशितं दाप्यः प्रतिषिद्धकृतं च यत् ।
असंदिष्टश् च यत् कुर्यात् सर्वैः संभूयकारिभिः ॥
transliteration: pramādān nāśitaṃ dāpyaḥ pratiṣiddhakṛtaṃ ca yat | asaṃdiṣṭaś ca yat kuryāt sarvaiḥ saṃbhūyakāribhiḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: He who destroys due to negligence, acts against prohibition, or performs unauthorized actions collectively with all agents, shall be made to restore what was destroyed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious capacity, not collective consensus
Causation arises through neglect, violation, or misalignment with directive
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by individual awareness, not group participation
Restoration logic demands reparation proportional to the disruption caused
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment and reversal of erroneous action
executable_legal_axioms: IF action_results_in_destruction AND agent_acted_negligently THEN initiate_restoration_process FOR responsible_agent
IF action_is_prohibited AND executed THEN enforce_completion_of_opposite_action BY actor
IF action_is_unauthorized AND performed_collectively THEN assign_individual_accountability BASED ON awareness_level
RESTORE = RECOVER + REINTEGRATE + REALIGN for affected_dharma_field
NO LIABILITY without CAUSAL AWARENESS in the acting entity
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, this verse establishes that even collective actions do not dilute individual accountability. The threshold of responsibility lies in the agent's conscious capacity at the time of the act. Courts must assess whether destruction stemmed from negligence, defiance, or unauthorized intent, applying restoration protocols accordingly.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies three error modes—negligence, violation, and unauthorized coordination. Each necessitates a proportional completion process rather than punitive consequence. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential correction aligns the actor’s consciousness back to dharma-field integrity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Destruction Reversal Process for material and energetic losses incurred
Assign Conscious Completion Task to restore balance disrupted by prohibited acts
Implement Group Accountability Dissolution Protocol to isolate individual awareness levels
Activate Dharma Field Realignment Sequence post-restitution
Verify Consciousness Reintegration via Nyāya-compliant audit trail
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
